subject: Office visit
text:
I am visiting as a customer.
Please tell me a time.
I prefer Thursday.
The morning is best.
I have a small favor.
Could you save me a parking spot?
The lot fills quickly.
It would help a lot.
I will bring documents.
We can sign the contract.
I will be brief.
No longer than thirty minutes.
Let me know if Tuesday works.
Please reply soon.
I need to plan travel.
Thank you for your help.

My daughter might join. She needs a badge. Please ask security. I can arrive early. We can meet first. Bring your team list. I need names. Also print copies. I can pay for it today.
